objective: Set the root's autocompact window to 450000 tokens, remove every size limit on instruction text, put the force-push rule back in the core, and fix three state and doctor defects.
scope: Autocompact: change the recommended and shipped modelSettings.claude-opus-5-5.autoCompactWindow from 200000 to 450000 (packages/runtime/src/setup/settings.ts, packages/runtime/src/cli/setup.ts, .claude/settings.json, docs such as docs/usage.md and docs/decisions.md, requirements text, tests).

Size limits: find and remove every character, byte, word or line cap on instruction text: in code, build checks, tests (for example a core cap of about 4100 characters or a root prompt byte budget), requirements.md and requirements/, docs, and instruction text, including any root rule that an instruction deliverable must state its expected size relative to the text it replaces. Replace a removed rule, where one is needed, with a plain instruction to keep the text terse and direct. Leave limits on report length that briefs set for specialist replies alone; they are not instruction-text caps. If a cap lives in .claude/CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md, do not edit it; name it in the report.

Force-push rule: restore 'never force-push, and never push to the base, default or a protected branch without the user's approval' to the core root text (packages/runtime/src/instructions/claude-5.5/root/identity.md or wherever the core is assembled), stated once there; the version-control section may refer to it instead of restating it.

Defect 1: holyagent doctor reports the effort setting as missing after the session effort is set with /effort auto; make doctor accept that state (read how /effort auto is stored by looking at the code that checks it) and test it.

Defect 2: a state fetch killed at its time limit (packages/runtime/src/state/tree.ts) can leave git helper child processes (ssh, credential helpers) running; kill the whole process group or otherwise ensure no helper survives, and test it.

Defect 3: the state commit runs git add -f -A over .holyagent excluding .holyagent/local, which force-adds any ignored file there; stage only the state files HolyAgent writes (or force-add past a .gitignore that ignores .holyagent/ as a whole while honoring ignores inside it), and test both the ignoring-.gitignore case and that a stray ignored file is not committed.
constraints: Follow .claude/CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md: Effect, Effect Schema, Bun APIs, JSDoc, Conventional style. Behavior changes go to packages/runtime/src/instructions/requirements.md first, then the instruction sets, then the generated plugin.
Keep all instruction text you touch terse and direct.
Make no version-control writes and no edits under .git/ or .holyagent/; report changed paths.

Keep working until everything asked is done; stop to ask only when you cannot go on. Do not add unrequested features or refactors; name them in the report. Run bun test, bun check, bun lint, bun fmt --check, then bun packages/integrations/claude/build.ts and rerun the tests. When done, stop and report under 450 words, each evidence entry on one line as '<criterion label>: <support>', with changed paths and a diff file /tmp/holyagent-review/limits.diff covering every changed file.

questions:
- `CONTEXT_BUDGET = 9300` (packages/runtime/src/cli/sessioncontext.ts, docs/hooks.md) and its tests are still in place. Claude Code cuts `additionalContext` at 10,000 characters and drops the tail silently. Removing the budget would let that cut hit the reminder, so I read it as a host limit rather than a cap on instruction text. If you want it gone too, say so.
- Defect 1 needs your call. The settings reference says `/effort auto` removes `effortLevel` from the model's `modelSettings` entry, so a cleared key looks the same as an unset one. Doctor and setup now skip the recommended `effortLevel` when the Opus 5.5 entry exists as an object without it. The cost is that an entry holding only `autoCompactWindow` (for example from `/autocompact`) no longer gets the effort recommendation. I could not check this against the installed Claude Code (2.1.42); I relied on the docs.
